About me

I started with programming and databases, then found that cloud computing connects everything I enjoy: how applications are built, where they run, and how they reach users.

Outside the classroom, I've worked on-site in an IT department, completed an online AI/ML internship, and spent time on a community awareness effort with an NGO. These experiences taught me to learn quickly, ask good questions and communicate clearly with different kinds of people.

Projects

Image Recognition using CNN

PythonCNNCIFAR-10

A deep learning model that classifies images from the CIFAR-10 dataset, which has 10 categories of everyday objects such as vehicles and animals. The model uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) to learn visual features from the images.

Cloud next step: train the model on a cloud VM with a GPU.

Student Grievance Redressal Portal

Diploma Final Year ProjectWeb Application

A web-based platform where students can submit complaints about academic issues, college facilities and other concerns. It gives the college one central place to manage complaints, lets students track the status of each one, and improves communication between students and college authorities. The goal is to make grievance handling more transparent, efficient and easy to access.

Cloud next step: host it on a cloud server so it is available online.
